preconditions.name: cells_share_one_substrate_hash
preconditions.description: The set of per-cell arm_fingerprint.substrate_hash values across ALL cells has cardinality exactly 1 -- every arm and seed ran on the SAME substrate build, so the ON-vs-control contrast is a controlled comparison. The 689d defect-3 gate.

preconditions.name: control_arms_produce_distinct_class_histograms
preconditions.description: No two control arms produce an identical committed-class count vector on the same seed. Guards the silent degradation of the conjunctive C_PRIMARY criterion ('strict above BOTH') to a single bar when two controls coincide. The 689d defect-2 gate.
preconditions.control: pairwise comparison of selected_class_counts across ARM_PROPOSER_CTRL / ARM_MATCHED_NOISE / ARM_OFF, per seed

preconditions.name: fresh_e3_selection_sufficiency_all_cells
preconditions.description: Every cell banked at least MIN_FRESH_SELECT_PER_CELL GENUINE E3 selections, measured by the substrate-inert sentinel key. Effective N, not env-step count, is the sample size for a class-histogram entropy. The 689d defect-1 / power gate.
preconditions.control: sentinel-key freshness marker on agent.e3.last_score_diagnostics, which e3_selector.select() reassigns wholesale at :2452

preconditions.name: matched_noise_control_verifiably_lifts
preconditions.description: The noise negative control raises committed-class entropy over the collapsed proposer baseline on >= MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS seeds, so 'ARM_ON beats it' is a REAL bar. Instantiated on Factor B's gap-scaled stochastic commit, where the sampling step is live on the committed path. GATING here; informational in 689d, where it fired false and the run passed anyway.

preconditions.name: on_modulatory_channel_route_range_supra_floor
preconditions.description: ARM_ON IN-ARM RAW cross-candidate RANGE of the modulatory bias routed into the E3 selection authority (modulatory_channel_route_range), read on GENUINE selections. SAME range statistic the route-range substrate gates on. Below floor => routing not wired / e2 under-trained => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: ARM_ON: candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward, route-range routing + shortlist-then-modulate + f_eligibility demotion ON

preconditions.name: on_e2_world_forward_prediction_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: ARM_ON e2.world_forward(z0, a_i) per-candidate prediction spread (cand_world_pairwise_dist) clears the floor -- SD-056 trained the action-conditional divergence the eligible set needs. RANGE statistic, read on genuine selections. Below floor => SD-056 under-trained => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: on_f_eligibility_envelope_excludes_on_divergent_pool
preconditions.description: ARM_ON f_eligibility demotion is active on >= DEMOTION_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR of GENUINE selections AND the envelope ACTUALLY EXCLUDES (mean f_eligibility_excluded_count > floor) on the divergent e2_world_forward pool. An all-admit envelope (excluded_count==0, a flat-F pool) is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue. Threshold UNCHANGED from 689d (0.0, strict >) -- adjudicated threshold-invariant.
preconditions.control: ARM_ON: use_f_eligibility_demotion=True over the divergent pool; f_eligibility_excluded_count read on genuine selections

routing.demotion_converts_committed_diversity: PASS -> MECH-448 toward supports on a REPAIRED instrument; restores the embodied env-loop pathway (genuine_exp_count 0 -> 1); ARC-107 gains its first validly-measured lever
routing.intra_run_substrate_divergence_invalid: cells did not share one substrate build -- the arms are not mutually controlled; the run is INVALID independent of every other criterion; re-run at a pinned commit on a cloud worker; NOT a weakens
routing.control_arms_not_distinct_invalid: two control arms produced identical committed-class histograms, so the conjunctive C_PRIMARY criterion degenerates to a single bar (the 689d defect-2 signature); repair the control before any verdict is read; NOT a weakens
routing.substrate_not_ready_requeue: insufficient GENUINE E3 selections per cell, OR routing/SD-056 under-trained, OR the pool is not divergent (all-admit envelope, excluded_count==0); re-queue; do NOT weaken MECH-448
routing.matched_noise_control_unmeetable: the noise negative control did not verifiably lift committed entropy over the collapsed proposer baseline, so 'ARM_ON beats it' is not a real bar -- the 689d defect-2 failure mode, now GATING; repair the control; NOT a weakens
routing.rank_alteration_not_prefix_diagnose: the eligible set is NOT an F-rank prefix (the envelope altered the F-rank) -> implementation/design fault -> /diagnose-errors; NOT a weakens
routing.conversion_ceiling_persists_despite_demo: OFF-RAMP -> the MECH-449 Go/No-Go eligibility constitution (double-gated) / the V4 directions; NOT a falsification of MECH-448
routing.demotion_disinhibits_harmful_classes: WEAKENED -- the committed-entropy lift came from globally flattening F / admitting harmful classes (C_SAFETY fail), the design-note weaken condition
